references.text: The peace offering (shelamim) is described in detail here, with instructions on how the various animals were to be sacrificed, including cattle, sheep, and goats.
Further laws concerning the peace offering, describing the priests' portion and how the sacrifice was to be eaten.
The first time the peace offering with the same number of animals is mentioned in this list of offerings, at Nahshon's offering.
Elisama's offering just before Gamaliel's offering, with an identical peace offering: two bulls, five rams, five male goats, and five one-year-old lambs.
Abidan's offering immediately after Gamaliel's offering, with an identical peace offering.
Gamaliel son of Pedahzur is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh.
Gamaliel son of Pedahzur is mentioned again as the leader of the people of Manasseh in the camp arrangement.
Gamaliel son of Pedahzur led the army of the tribe of Manasseh during the wilderness journey.
